_readme: The five formative fields the pack prints for every lesson, extracted verbatim.
successCriteria is written for students and is shown to them before the worksheet.
targets, check and evidence are teacher planning language and are stripped from the
student payload by stripAnswerKey_ — they belong beside a judgement, not on a lesson.
Source: Grade 6 Curriculum and Sample Core Lesson, per-lesson formative assessment block.

g6-bridging-w1-core.targets: Grade 5 Advanced: explains how data quality affects AI outputs
g6-bridging-w1-core.check: Data-quality contrast task: predict, reveal, explain the output difference
g6-bridging-w1-core.successCriteria: Explains the data-quality to output link with an example and predicts the effect of a quality change.

g6-bridging-w1-lab.targets: Grade 5 Advanced: explains how data quality affects AI outputs
g6-bridging-w1-lab.check: Four-way contrast plus ranking task with written justification
g6-bridging-w1-lab.successCriteria: Ranks datasets by expected output quality and justifies the order using evidence from the output changes.
g6-bridging-w1-lab.evidence: Investigation log and ranking line with justification.

g6-bridging-w2-core.targets: Grade 5 Advanced: refines prompts to improve output quality and explains why
g6-bridging-w2-core.check: Prompt-refinement log: v1 to v2 with a reasoned justification
g6-bridging-w2-core.successCriteria: Makes a refinement that measurably improves the output and explains the causal reason.

g6-bridging-w2-lab.targets: Grade 5 Advanced: refines prompts to improve output quality and explains why
g6-bridging-w2-lab.check: Iteration log across several versions plus a two-goal trade-off justification
g6-bridging-w2-lab.successCriteria: Iterates a prompt with a reasoned log and chooses a best-balanced version, explaining the trade-off with evidence.
g6-bridging-w2-lab.evidence: Multi-version refinement log with trade-off note.

g6-bridging-w3-core.targets: Grade 4 Advanced: explains how data influences the outcome of a solution
g6-bridging-w3-core.check: Data-to-outcome explanation on a worked solution (with a 'what if the data changed' probe)
g6-bridging-w3-core.successCriteria: Correctly explains the data's influence and predicts the effect of a data change.

g6-bridging-w3-lab.targets: Grade 4 Advanced: explains how data influences the outcome of a solution
g6-bridging-w3-lab.check: Investigation log showing before/after outcomes for several single data swaps, plus a ranked conclusion
g6-bridging-w3-lab.successCriteria: Records outcomes for controlled single swaps and identifies, with evidence, the most influential change.
g6-bridging-w3-lab.evidence: Completed investigation log + one-sentence evidence-based conclusion.

g6-bridging-w4-core.targets: Grade 5 Advanced: explains misinformation risks and proposes verification strategies
g6-bridging-w4-core.check: Risk-and-verify card: name the misinformation risk + a verification step
g6-bridging-w4-core.successCriteria: Explains a plausible misinformation risk and proposes a workable verification strategy with a reason.

g6-bridging-w4-lab.targets: Grade 5 Advanced: explains misinformation risks and proposes verification strategies
g6-bridging-w4-lab.check: Completed verification workshop sheet with verdicts and evidence for a batch, plus a reasoned comparison of two strategies
g6-bridging-w4-lab.successCriteria: Applies the routine to reach evidence-based verdicts and judges which verification strategy is more reliable with a reason.
g6-bridging-w4-lab.evidence: Workshop sheet with per-output verdicts + strategy comparison and judgement.

g6-bridging-w5-core.targets: Integrated mastery - CU (data quality affects outputs) and SD (design a promptdriven solution)
g6-bridging-w5-core.check: Helper design planner + clean-vs-noisy data test reviewed against the mastery criteria
g6-bridging-w5-core.successCriteria: Designs a helper with a clear task, structured prompt and data, and explains how data quality changed the output.
g6-bridging-w5-core.evidence: Completed helper planner (Trustworthy AI Helper Log, Part 1).

g6-bridging-w5-lab.targets: Integrated mastery - SD (refine prompts to improve output quality and explain why)
g6-bridging-w5-lab.check: Prompt-refinement log (v1 to best) with a reasoned justification for the key change
g6-bridging-w5-lab.successCriteria: Iterates the prompt to a measurably better output and explains the causal reason for the improvement.
g6-bridging-w5-lab.evidence: Prompt-refinement log (Trustworthy AI Helper Log, Part 1 Lab).

g6-bridging-w6-core.targets: Integrated mastery - CE (data influences the outcome) and planning for GE (verification and risk)
g6-bridging-w6-core.check: Data-influence trace + verification/risk plan on the Log, reviewed against the mastery criteria
g6-bridging-w6-core.successCriteria: Explains the data's influence on the outcome, predicts a data change, and plans a trustedsource verification and a risk check.
g6-bridging-w6-core.evidence: Trustworthy AI Helper Log, Part 2 (Core section).

g6-bridging-w6-lab.targets: Integrated mastery confirmation - GE (verification and risk) with CU, SD, CE from earlier, plus reflection
g6-bridging-w6-lab.check: Completed verification + risk mitigation on the Log, a one-minute showcase, and the four-skill reflection
g6-bridging-w6-lab.successCriteria: Verifies a claim against a trusted source, applies a risk mitigation (refining if needed), argues trust with evidence, presents, and reflects across the four skills.
g6-bridging-w6-lab.evidence: Trustworthy AI Helper Log (Part 2 Lab) and observed showcase.

g6-main-w1-core.targets: Baseline for the rule-based vs learning-system distinction and safe-use norms
g6-main-w1-core.check: Diagnostic KWL + question wall + rule/learning sort (not graded)
g6-main-w1-core.successCriteria: Poses at least 2 genuine questions and sorts at least 2 of 3 systems with a reason.
g6-main-w1-core.evidence: Sorted systems + question wall on the baseline sheet.

g6-main-w1-lab.targets: Checks whether students can observe and articulate the rule-based vs learning distinction through investigation
g6-main-w1-lab.check: Comparison log with at least three logged differences and one devised test
g6-main-w1-lab.successCriteria: Logs at least three real differences and writes a test that would actually separate rules from learning.
g6-main-w1-lab.evidence: Completed comparison log and the group's devised test.

g6-main-w10-core.targets: Summative Term-1 task samples all four strands at Emerging; reflection informs Term 2
g6-main-w10-core.check: Short Term-1 performance task marked with the analytic rubric + structured self-reflection
g6-main-w10-core.successCriteria: Demonstrates each strand at Emerging; articulates two justified design/evaluation choices.
g6-main-w10-core.evidence: Assessed task + reflection; results reported per strand.

g6-main-w10-lab.targets: Summative Term-1 task samples all four strands at Emerging; reflection informs Term 2
g6-main-w10-lab.check: Structured peer feedback across the carousel plus a completed four-strand summary and Term-2 goal
g6-main-w10-lab.successCriteria: Gives specific strand-tagged feedback, confirms responsible use, and sets one clear Term-2 goal.
g6-main-w10-lab.evidence: Feedback slips + completed four-strand Emerging summary with goal.

g6-main-w2-core.targets: Directly checks 'recognises the difference between rule-based and learning systems'
g6-main-w2-core.check: Exit ticket: classify two systems and give the feature that distinguishes them
g6-main-w2-core.successCriteria: Correctly classifies both and names a distinguishing feature (not a surface trait).
g6-main-w2-core.evidence: Exit slips sorted secure / partial / not-yet.

g6-main-w2-lab.targets: Deepens 'recognises the difference between rule-based and learning systems' by building a learning system and seeing how data shapes it
g6-main-w2-lab.check: Training-and-testing log with results and an explanation of how the data shaped the model
g6-main-w2-lab.successCriteria: Trains and tests a model on separate example sets and explains how the training examples changed what it learned.
g6-main-w2-lab.evidence: Completed training/testing log plus the data-safety and risk check.

g6-main-w3-core.targets: Directly checks 'uses AI tools with structured prompts to complete tasks'
g6-main-w3-core.check: Task-completion log: structured prompt, output, 'task complete?' + one adjustment
g6-main-w3-core.successCriteria: Completes the task using a structured prompt and records one adjustment that improved completion.

g6-main-w3-lab.targets: Extends 'uses AI tools with structured prompts to complete tasks' toward reusable, evaluated solutions
g6-main-w3-lab.check: A reusable prompt template plus a comparison of two structures with accuracy checks
g6-main-w3-lab.successCriteria: Compares two structures on completion and accuracy and designs a reusable template with a verification step.
g6-main-w3-lab.evidence: Comparison notes and the reusable template with its risk check.

g6-main-w4-core.targets: Directly checks 'identifies when outputs are incorrect or unclear'
g6-main-w4-core.check: Output-triage exit card: flag correct / incorrect / unclear with a reason each
g6-main-w4-core.successCriteria: Correctly triages at least 2 of 3 outputs and gives a valid reason for each judgement.

g6-main-w4-lab.targets: Directly checks 'identifies when outputs are incorrect or unclear'
g6-main-w4-lab.check: Completed clinic record sheet plus a defended trust-ladder ranking
g6-main-w4-lab.successCriteria: Triages the full set with valid reasons, chooses a verification action each, and defends a sensible ranking.
g6-main-w4-lab.evidence: Clinic record sheet and trust ladder photo.

g6-main-w5-core.targets: Directly checks 'recognises basic risks (incorrect outputs, unsafe use)'
g6-main-w5-core.check: Risk-spotting exit card: name two risks + one responsible-use rule
g6-main-w5-core.successCriteria: Names two genuine risks, explains who is affected, and states a matching responsible-use rule.

g6-main-w5-lab.targets: Directly checks 'recognises basic risks (incorrect outputs, unsafe use)'
g6-main-w5-lab.check: Completed audit sheet with a matrix-placed priority risk and a proposed mitigation rule
g6-main-w5-lab.successCriteria: Finds a genuine gap, places risks sensibly on the matrix, and proposes a realistic rule that reduces the top risk.
g6-main-w5-lab.evidence: Audit sheet and risk matrix photo.

g6-main-w6-core.targets: Integrates all Term-1 Emerging outcomes before the signature solution
g6-main-w6-core.check: Guided integration task reviewed against project success criteria; forward feedback
g6-main-w6-core.successCriteria: Connects system+prompt to output, triages the output, and names a risk-reduction choice.

g6-main-w6-lab.targets: Integrates all Term-1 Emerging outcomes end-to-end as a rehearsal for the signature solution
g6-main-w6-lab.check: Completed build-and-check record with accuracy verdict, risk verdict, use decision, and weakeststrand diagnosis
g6-main-w6-lab.successCriteria: Runs all four strands end-to-end, records both checks, makes a justified use decision, and names a weakest strand.

g6-main-w7-core.targets: Checks planning of the signature solution against the Emerging project criteria
g6-main-w7-core.check: Plan review against the project rubric (Emerging); approve-to-build gate
g6-main-w7-core.successCriteria: Plan states goal, prompt structure, inputs, an evaluation method, and one risk mitigation.

g6-main-w7-lab.targets: Checks that the plan survives a tricky input and gains a fallback branch
g6-main-w7-lab.check: Build/test log review: one normal run, one pressure test, one fallback branch, one logged change
g6-main-w7-lab.successCriteria: Prototype is run, a tricky input exposes a weak spot, and a fallback branch plus a logged reason are added.
g6-main-w7-lab.evidence: Completed build/test log with fallback branch.

g6-main-w8-core.targets: Monitors build against the plan; each student logs one evaluation-based improvement
g6-main-w8-core.check: Build check-in against plan + one logged improvement ('evaluate -> change -> result')
g6-main-w8-core.successCriteria: Solution follows the plan, outputs are evaluated, and one improvement is made and explained.

g6-main-w8-lab.targets: Confirms a completed solution is evaluated across several inputs, handles a failure, and passes a basic risk check
g6-main-w8-lab.check: Test-set evaluation log (accuracy count) + documented fix + completed risk check
g6-main-w8-lab.successCriteria: Solution is completed, evaluated across several inputs with an accuracy count, a failure is handled gracefully, and the risk check confirms no personal data.
g6-main-w8-lab.evidence: Completed test-set log, documented fix, and risk-check sheet.

g6-main-w9-core.targets: Self- and peer-evaluation against the tiered rubric (Emerging = expected)
g6-main-w9-core.check: Structured self/peer review using the rubric; one improvement acted upon
g6-main-w9-core.successCriteria: Meets the Emerging criteria; names an accuracy/usefulness/risk judgement and one improvement.

g6-main-w9-lab.targets: Self- and peer-evaluation against the tiered rubric (Emerging = expected)
g6-main-w9-lab.check: Final iteration completed and a full risk review with a safe-and-fair statement
g6-main-w9-lab.successCriteria: Meets the Emerging criteria; completes a risk matrix, acts on one improvement, and confirms no personal data is used.
g6-main-w9-lab.evidence: Final iteration log + completed risk matrix + safe-and-fair statement.
